blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sophie works in the accounting team at Czarnikow. Today she teaches a new trainee. The lesson is called Simple Accounting Mistakes.

Sophie says accounting is the language of numbers. The numbers must be clear and honest. Everyone makes a mistake sometimes. That is normal. The important thing is to fix it.

Sophie is calm and kind. She uses short words. "Check your work," she says. "When you find a mistake, fix it and learn from it. You can say sorry, and then you move on." One careful step at a time — that is how good accountants work.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "Sophie works in the accounting team at Czarnikow."

items.q: According to Sophie, the numbers must be…
items.why: "The numbers must be clear and honest."

items.q: What does Sophie say to do when you find a mistake?
options: Ask a manager to do it
Fix it and learn from it
items.why: "When you find a mistake, fix it and learn from it."

items.q: Sophie would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Learning from a mistake is good.
A mistake is normal, and you can fix it.
A small mistake is a big problem you must hide.
items.why: Inferência: para a Sophie, o erro é normal e se corrige — não é algo para esconder.

items.q: "One careful step at a time" suggests that Sophie wants the trainee to…
options: count the steps to the office
items.why: Inferência: a frase mostra que ela valoriza calma e cuidado, não pressa.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com o novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. I'm Sophie. Don't worry — this is easy. We work with numbers every day, and I will help you. This is your first day, so we go slow.

Here is my first tip. Always check your work. Look at the numbers two times. It takes one minute, but it saves a lot of problems. A small mistake in a report can be a big problem later.

Yesterday I made a small mistake. I typed the wrong number in the report. But I stayed calm. I found it, I fixed it, and I said sorry to my manager. She was fine. Mistakes happen to everyone. The important thing is to fix them fast and stay honest.

So, three simple words for you today: check, fix, learn. Check your work. Fix the mistake. Learn from it. Do that every day, and you will be a great accountant. And when you are not sure, just ask me. I am here to help.

Take it slow. One step at a time. You can do it.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's first tip?
items.why: "Always check your work. Look at the numbers two times."

items.q: What mistake did Sophie make yesterday?
options: She typed the wrong number in the report
items.why: "I typed the wrong number in the report."

items.q: What did Sophie do after she found the mistake?
options: She fixed it and said sorry to her manager
She asked the trainee to fix it
items.why: "I found it, I fixed it, and I said sorry to my manager."

items.q: Why does Sophie tell this story about her own mistake?
options: To say the trainee is slow
To ask for help with the numbers
To show that mistakes are normal and can be fixed
items.why: Inferência: ela conta o próprio erro para tranquilizar o trainee — errar é normal e tem conserto.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the trainee's first day?
items.why: Inferência: "Don't worry", "Take it slow", "You can do it" mostram um tom calmo e de apoio.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I made a small mistake in the report." A mistake is…
items.why: Mistake = erro.

items.q: "Don't worry, I can fix the number." To fix means to…
items.why: Fix = corrigir, deixar certo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please ___ the numbers two times before you send the report."
items.why: Check = verificar; olhar de novo para ter certeza.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I want to ___ from my mistakes and do better."
items.why: Learn (from) = aprender com.

items.q: "I said sorry to my manager." You say sorry when…
items.why: Sorry = desculpa; você diz quando errou ou fez algo errado.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please write down the number here." To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar, escrever no papel.

items.q: "Can you go over the report with me?" To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, checar com cuidado.

items.q: "I will sort out this problem today." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, arrumar.

items.q: "She owned up to the mistake." She…
items.why: Own up to = assumir, admitir que o erro foi seu.

items.q: "Take it slow and you will keep up with the team." To keep up means to…
items.why: Keep up = acompanhar, ficar no mesmo ritmo.
